results.title: Koeman: Uzbekistan friendly will help fine-tune Netherlands starting side
highlights:
Koeman: Uzbekistan friendly will help fine-tune Netherlands starting side
[...]
# Koeman: Uzbekistan friendly will help fine-tune Netherlands starting side
[...]
### The Netherlands conclude their World Cup preparations against Uzbekistan, and Ronald Koeman is using the friendly as a dress rehearsal.
[...]
Ronald Koeman said that Monday's friendly against Uzbekistan will be used to fine-tune his starting line-up for the Netherlands' opening game at the World Cup.
[...]
Netherlands take on World Cup debutants Uzbekistan at Icahn Stadium, hoping to bounce back from their shock 1-0 defeat to Algeria before they jetted off to North America.
[...]
Koeman made the decision to replace his entire team against Algeria, with six of those changes coming at half-time, including Virgil van Dijk and Micky van de Ven.
[...]
Netherlands come up against an Uzbekistan side that were beaten 2-0 by co-hosts Canada last time out, while it will also be the first ever meeting between the two nations.
[...]
And while Koeman insisted that almost every player within his 26-man squad would play in their final World Cup warm-up, he said the team that lines up to start the match will likely be the one that faces Japan in their Group F opener on June 14.
[...]
"We want to use the first ​match to make as few changes as possible. We have ⁠to wait and see if that works," Koeman told reporters.
[...]
"We are going to play ​the first match largely with our starting team. It is also good for guys who are not 100% fit who can then play in the second match.
[...]
"That ​is why we are playing two matches. We have 26 players and everyone ​gets minutes to play. That's what you want."
[...]
Netherlands also face Sweden and Tunisia in their other group fixtures as they aim to improve on their quarter-final exit to Argentina in Qatar four years ago.
[...]
And one player who will be hoping to play his way into Koeman's side is Jurrien Timber, who featured in Arsenal's Champions League final defeat to Paris Saint-Germain.
[...]
Timber had been sidelined with a groin injury, and the Netherlands boss conceded that there were still some concerns surrounding the defender's fitness.
[...]
"If he ⁠trains and is fully fit, he always makes a good impression. That hasn't been the case every day, so ​we have to make a decision," Koeman added.
[...]
"He ​participated in ⁠training, and we are going to sit down with the doctor and Jurrien at the end of [Sunday] afternoon to see whether he is going to start ⁠or ​not."

results.title: Netherlands boss Koeman does not expect total football in World Cup heat
highlights:
Netherlands boss Koeman does not expect total football in World Cup heat
[...]
# Netherlands boss Koeman does not expect total football in World Cup heat
[...]
### The Netherlands will look to play on the front foot at the World Cup, though Ronald Koeman knows conditions could require them to adapt.
[...]
Ronald Koeman believes it is unrealistic to expect his Netherlands side to play high-pressing, 'total football' for 90 minutes in the hot conditions they will encounter at the World Cup.
[...]
The Oranje will open their Group F campaign against Japan in Arlington in June 14, before taking on Sweden in Houston six days later.
[...]
Both AT&T Stadium and NRG Stadium – their first two venues – feature retractable roofs and should be protected from the worst of the hot summer weather, but their final group game against Tunisia will be played in Kansas City, where hot and humid weather is likely.
[...]
The Netherlands will face Algeria and Uzbekistan in pre-tournament friendlies on Wednesday and Monday, with the former taking place on home soil in Amsterdam.
[...]
And while Koeman would prefer to see his team play with intensity and press their opponents back, he knows they may have to make adjustments at times.
[...]
"We need to let the players recognise how we can solve the opponent's pressure with three or four defenders, by creating the extra man, making depth between the lines, depth without the ball," Koeman said.
[...]
"These are all things that can be improved. You give attention to that, and then you're only talking about your own ball possession.
[...]
"You also pay attention to applying pressure, although I don't believe that with the heat in America it is possible to put pressure on the opponent for 90 minutes. But it is important to recognise this compared to the opponents."
[...]
group, and they achieved
[...]
results with an easy-on-the-eye style.
[...]
Koeman's side also ranked fifth for successful passes, with 4,558, while they also had a 66.2% average possession share.
[...]
Reflecting on their tactical approach, Koeman added: "We prefer to have the ball for ninety minutes and determine things, but that's not always the case in football.
[...]
"If you don't have the ball, you have to be able to solve it and defend it well. Then you know that with the quality and speed we have up front and in midfield, we have a big weapon."
[...]
Koeman has also taken the Netherlands back to using a 4-3-3 formation after they regularly played a back three under Louis van Gaal, and he plans to stick with that shape.
[...]
"I still think that if you talk about your own ball possession, you get opponents into much more trouble by playing with four men at the back than when you mirror them," Koeman said.

results.title: Netherlands vs Japan team news and predicted lineups | Squawka | EN
highlights:
## Netherlands vs Japan team news
[...]
Ronald Koeman had to make a late change to his Netherlands squad for the World Cup. Jurrien Timber had been a doubt ahead of the tournament following an injury, but featured in the Champions League final. However, the Dutch FA have decided that it wouldn’t be medically responsible for Timber to take part at the World Cup. He has been replaced in the squad by Lutsharel Geertruida.
[...]
Denzel Dumfries looks likely to start at right-back for the Netherlands, with Geertruida offering an option from the bench. On the other side, Micky van de Ven appears to be the favourite, with Virgil van Dijk and Jan Paul van Hecke playing through the middle. A Premier League-heavy defence is set to be completed by Bart Verbruggen in goal.
[...]
Further forward, Ryan Gravenberch, Frenkie de Jong and Tijjani Reijnders are set to be the midfield trio. The latter will likely push into more of a No.10 role, with De Jong and Gravenberch sitting deeper in a double pivot. Crysencio Summerville as been Ronald Koeman’s favourite on the right wing, with Cody Gakpo on the left. Memphis Depay is expected to lead the line.
[...]
Unlike a lot of other nations, Japan only had one pre-tournament friendly, against Iceland. But their starting XI seems pretty set, and Japan appear ready to deal with the absense of Kaoru Mitoma who will miss the World Cup through injury. Takefusa Kubo and Junya Ito are set to play in the supportive attacking roles in Japan’s 3-4-2-1 formation. Ayase Ueda will lead the line after his phenomenal club season.
[...]
Ritsu Doan has emerged as a favoured for the right-wing-back role, taking it ahead of Yukinari Sugawara. Keito Nakamura is set to start on the left, though Yuto Nagatomo provides years of experience as a backup. In the middle, Wataru Endo had to withdraw from the squad on the eve of the tournament due to injury, subsequently retiring from international football. Daichi Kamada is set to start in Endo’s stead, with Leeds United midfielder Ao Tanaka likely to partner him.
[...]
## Netherland vs Japan predicted lineups
[...]
Netherlands (4-2-3-1): Verbruggen; Dumfries, van Hecke, van Dijk, van de Ven; de Jong, Gravenberch; Summerville, Reijnders, Gakpo; Depay.
[...]
Japan (3-4-2-1): Suzuki; Tomiyasu, Itakura, Watanabe; Doan, Endo, Tanaka, Nakamura; Kubo, J Ito; Ueda.
